decisions.reason: The reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry business, is publicly presented as a flagship, and has been shown on the home page in both years, so commitment to it is strong.

The risk management software builds on the established offer and supports the announced integration and prediction direction, so management will treat slow uptake as a temporary market-adoption issue.
The CT phantom is a recent extension of the imaging QA line the firm has made a focus, and the investment in it is too new to judge as failed.
Although it is distant from the core business, the mammography phantom belongs to the newly announced imaging QA push, so management will justify it as part of that strategic expansion.
This second mammography phantom is the most peripheral item and overlaps with Product D, but its recent launch and dedicated page make dropping it within a year unlikely.
The multi-model imaging QA instrument line is a publicly declared flagship of the firm's direction with substantial investment, so the firm is highly committed to it.
